protocol: One warmup, two complete position rotations per implementation, forward wall from QEMU start to UART; all slow runs included.
verification: All normal raw outputs reread and bitwise matched the complete ORT reference. Finite inputs overflowing the tail row returned guest status 2.

selection: After the two initial screens, 5x4-cached was nominated for the independent third batch. The fourth batch compares the two K panel layouts at the same 5x4 tile and cached writeback.
decision: Keep 5x4-cached as an optional probe. Median advantages over the existing 4x4 varied across three batches (3.65%, 5.12%, 0.08%). No experiment reached 1.5x relative to the same-batch original.
error_scope: Each error run uses finite inputs that overflow calculations in row 255 of head 15. Guest UART status, no successful output dump and process cleanup are verified; caller output preservation and workspace reuse are checked in host C.
